items.title: Zach Lowe, Nate Duncan, and Noa Dalzell think the Celtics will or should start Mitchell Robinson over Neemias Queta to avoid Hack-a-Mitch later in quarters. Is this the first time it's made sense to start a player (on a non tanking team) because they were especially bad at something?
